name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.qzSep
source: ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[l] M] (m : M), m ≠ 0 → ∃ f : M →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l, f m ≠ 0 := by
obtain ⟨x, hx0, hx⟩ := exists_qz_ne_zero_annihilators_of_ne_zero l M m hm
set K := LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ_[l] M m) with hK
have hle : K ≤ LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ_[l] (QZ l) x) := by
let f := K.liftQ (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ_[l] M m) le_rfl
let g := K.liftQ (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ_[l] (QZ l) x) hle
have hf : Function.Injective f := LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp (K.ker_liftQ_eq_bot _ _ le_rfl)
obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Module.Injective.out f hf g
simp only [f, g, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.liftQ_apply, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply,
show: For any prime ℓ, any ℤℓ-module M and any nonzero m ∈ M, some ℤℓ-linear functional from M to ℚℓ/ℤℓ takes a nonzero value at m.
strategy: Construct a functional on the cyclic submodule generated by m, then extend it by injectivity.

steps.claim: For nonzero m ∈ M, choose a nonzero x ∈ ℚℓ/ℤℓ such that every scalar killing m also kills x. Put K = {a ∈ ℤℓ | am = 0}, the kernel of the map a ↦ am.
steps.snippet:
∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[l] M] (m : M), m ≠ 0 → ∃ f : M →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l, f m ≠ 0 := by
  intro l _ M _ _ m hm
  obtain ⟨x, hx0, hx⟩ := exists_qz_ne_zero_annihilators_of_ne_zero l M m hm
  set K := LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ_[l] M m) with hK

steps.claim: If a ∈ K then am = 0, so the choice of x gives ax = 0. Thus K is contained in the kernel of a ↦ ax.
steps.snippet:
have hle : K ≤ LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ_[l] (QZ l) x) := by
    intro a ha
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply] at ha ⊢
    exact hx a ha

steps.claim: Let f,g be the maps out of ℤℓ/K given by f(a+K) = am in M and g(a+K) = ax in ℚℓ/ℤℓ. Both are well defined because K annihilates m and x.
steps.snippet:
let f := K.liftQ (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ_[l] M m) le_rfl
  let g := K.liftQ (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ_[l] (QZ l) x) hle

steps.claim: The map f is injective. Its kernel consists of classes a+K with am = 0, and this condition is exactly a ∈ K.
steps.snippet: have hf : Function.Injective f := LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp (K.ker_liftQ_eq_bot _ _ le_rfl)

steps.claim: Injectivity of ℚℓ/ℤℓ as an ℤℓ-module extends g along f to a character h on M with h ∘ f = g. Evaluating at 1+K gives h(m) = x ≠ 0, exhibiting the required character.
steps.snippet:
haveI := UpperTheory.V.PropA.qzInj l
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Module.Injective.out f hf g
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  have h1 := hh (K.mkQ 1)
  simp only [f, g, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.liftQ_apply, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply,
    one_smul] at h1
  rw [h1]
  exact hx0

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
